$meta.title: Median full time weekly pay against England, workplace and resident, 2016 to 2026

measures.definition: ASHE gross weekly pay, median of full time employees on adult rates whose pay was not affected by absence, April, employee jobs located in the area (place of work)
ASHE gross weekly pay, median of full time employees on adult rates whose pay was not affected by absence, April, employees living in the area (place of residence)

$meta.table: ASHE Tables 7.1a and 8.1a, sheet Full-Time; CVs from Tables 7.1b and 8.1b
$meta.edition: 2016 to 2025 revised editions; 2026 provisional, released 22 October 2026
$meta.citation: ONS (2017 to 2026) Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings, Tables 7 and 8
$meta.caveat: A sample estimate. Burnley's medians carry coefficients of variation of 5.4% to 9.6%; the ONS calls 5% to 10% reasonably precise.
$meta.rules: No person is named. Companies are named only in the largest filers panel, from their own filed accounts. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
